howWeDoIt.headline: Structured execution and partner accountability
points: The company keeps land acquisition and finance in-house.
It gives construction management, sales and marketing, third-party checks, and other processes to partners.
It does this to make each partner more accountable to HNI and UHNWI investors, funds, retail buyers, end users, and landowners.
